notes.title: Update 0.1.7
notes.content:
[b]Keybindings update[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Partial Controller support
[*] Fixed axis input keybindings not updating
[*] Fixed in game keybinding not working
[*] Added Secondary keybindings
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed ruins level allowing camera to go outside
[*] Fixed ruins level flickering blocks
[*] Fixed flickering boxes when overlapping with ghost blocks
[/list]
[b]UI Update[/b]
[list]
[*] Create universal, more modern UI buttons
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.1.6
notes.content:
[b]Steam Leaderboards Added[/b]
[list]
[*] Overall High Scores will be tracked
[*] Individual map highest scores will be tracked
[*] These can be viewed from the community page -> View Stats
[/list]
[b]Performance increases[/b]
[list]
[*] Network replication updated
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.1.5
notes.content:
[b]New Tutorial Added[/b]
[list]
[*] New level designed to help new players get started
[*] Step by step instructions on how to play
[*] Access by selecting it in single player mode
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the first next block in multiplayer not displaying correctly
[*] Random block no longer appears in the middle of maps
[*] Screen no longer rotates when menu is up
[*] Blocks no longer sometimes stack on some invisible blocks
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.1.4
notes.content:
[b]Lobby Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]Games can now be private
[*]Now possible to invite from friends list
[*]Can now kick player from the lobby if you are the host
[/list]
[b]Quality of Life menu changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Type enabled fields are set to automatically focus
[*]Updated Spacing between buttons
[*]Finding lobby automatically finds a match when navigating to window
[/list]

notes.title: Reviewer Bonus
notes.content:
[h1]Free Copy with Review[/h1]
Gomen Gaming is proud to announce that, upon release of Stackems, we will be providing a free additional copy of the game to the first 20 users who provide a product review after initial purchase([u]Positive or Negative[/u]).

With this extra copy, we hope to encourage customer feedback and allow those that did review to experience the multiplayer aspect of the game that we would like to expand on.

[i]Additional information on how to receive key with be given upon review.[/i]
